script_text: Stop! Aries, the sky is pressing a pressure point right now. On November 22, 2026, the Sun enters Sagittarius in your 9th House and trines Saturn in Aries in your 1st House, while Mars, your fiery ruling planet, heats your 4th House of home and roots. This fire-sign trine turns a private tension into visible discipline, so the battle is not against others but against your own hesitation. In love, if you are taken, do not let pride freeze a sensitive conversation; if single, avoid anyone who tests your worth instead of seeing it. Career and money: Saturn in your 1st House backs a formal request through the 10th House, especially a title, raise, or long-term contract. Warning: avoid signing anything until you review every line twice, especially anything tied to family property or shared money. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
